[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] '''Jesrella''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] character played by the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] star [[Levi Schoen]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. While filming a scene that depicted the coronation of Queen Jesrella, Schoen was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Melo Centris]].<ref name="POA" />
